angles.name: One of one
angles.hook: Your iPad, dressed for the meeting.
angles.primary_short: Your iPad, dressed for the meeting. Each Seronera iPad cover in Nile crocodile leather has its own arrangement of scales, so the one you choose is yours alone. €250 · free shipping · duties & taxes included.
angles.primary_long: Most covers are made to be identical. Ours cannot be. The front of every Seronera iPad cover is cut from a single piece of Nile crocodile belly skin, so its natural pattern runs uninterrupted across the cover. No two arrangements of scales are the same, so the one you open each morning is yours alone. Genuine, CITES certified leather from our own farm on the Sabie River. For iPad Pro and iPad Air, 11" and 13". €250, free shipping, duties & taxes included.
angles.headline: Uninterrupted scales · €250

angles.name: Sabie River origin
angles.hook: From the banks of the Sabie River to your desk.
angles.primary_short: From the banks of the Sabie River to your desk. The leather on our iPad cover comes from our own farm in Hazyview, South Africa, founded in 1997. €250, free shipping, duties & taxes included.
angles.primary_long: Our farm was founded in 1997 on the banks of the Sabie River in Hazyview, Mpumalanga. Today, leather from that farm becomes the front of this iPad cover: a single piece of Nile crocodile belly skin, its natural pattern running uninterrupted across the cover. Genuine and CITES certified, from a brand that gives back to South African communities through education initiatives and orphanages. €250, shipped free from the EU, duties & taxes included.
angles.headline: River farm to desk · €250

angles.name: Desk and days away
angles.hook: Made for the desk and the days away from it.
angles.primary_short: Made for the desk and the days away from it. A Nile crocodile leather iPad cover that gives a familiar everyday essential an individual finish. For iPad Pro and Air, 11" and 13". €250, free shipping.
angles.primary_long: Morning notes at the desk. A flight to somewhere warm. A long table after dinner, plans sketched out. Your iPad goes everywhere, so its cover should say something quietly. Ours is Nile crocodile leather, the front cut from a single piece of belly skin so the pattern runs uninterrupted. Black, Cognac, Tobacco, Red, Mink and Grendec, for iPad Pro and iPad Air in 11" and 13". €250, free shipping, duties & taxes included.
angles.headline: Desk to departure lounge · €250

angles.name: The everyday gift
angles.hook: A gift they will use every working day.
angles.primary_short: A gift they will use every working day. The Seronera iPad cover in genuine Nile crocodile leather, each one with its own scale pattern. €250, free shipping, duties & taxes included.
angles.primary_long: Some gifts are put away. This one goes to work. A Seronera iPad cover brings Nile crocodile leather to the meetings, notes and travel of an ordinary week, and no one else will have the same one: the front is cut from a single piece of belly skin, and each cover has its own arrangement of scales. Genuine, CITES certified, from our farm on the Sabie River in South Africa. Choose the colour and iPad size; it ships free from the EU, duties & taxes included. €250.

angles.primary_short: One piece of belly skin. One uninterrupted pattern. That is the front of the Seronera iPad cover in Nile crocodile leather, genuine and CITES certified. €250, free shipping, duties & taxes included.

scenes.name: Walnut study at dusk
scenes.prompt: Luxury product photograph, one single continuous photograph, square frame. Use the reference photo as the exact product: a Seronera iPad cover in Cognac crocodile leather, a warm cognac brown, its front cut from a single piece of Nile crocodile belly skin with the natural rectangular scale pattern running uninterrupted across it - keep shape, colour, scale pattern, stitching and hardware identical, do not redesign it. The closed cover lies flat on a dark oiled walnut desk, seen from a gentle elevated three-quarter angle, the whole product visible and uncropped. Setting: a quiet private study at dusk, warm low side light from the left raking softly across the scales, a soft natural shadow beneath the cover. Composition: product horizontally centred, its whole outline between 32% and 75% of the image height and between 20% and 80% of the image width; the top 30% of the square is only empty background, a deep shadowed dark green-grey wall with no objects; everything below 77% of the image height is only empty walnut surface. Nothing else on the desk, no props. No people, no hands, no animals. No text, letters, logos, Apple logo or watermarks anywhere. Photorealistic, medium-format camera. resolution: 2k

audience: Women and men aged 30-65 in core EU markets (NL, BE, DE, FR, IT, AT) with interests in Apple iPad Pro, luxury leather goods, quiet-luxury fashion, business and first-class travel, interior design and fine stationery, layered with Engaged Shoppers. Retarget site visitors and Instagram/Facebook engagers, test a 1-3% lookalike of purchasers, and add a Q4 gift-buyer segment (interest in luxury gifts, corporate gifting) for the gift angle.
issues_fixed: Angle 'Sabie River origin' primary_long: 'In 1997 we founded our farm' says the brand founded the farm, which the sources do not state. The site only says the farm was founded in 1997. Rewritten as 'Our farm was founded in 1997 on the banks of the Sabie River in Hazyview, Mpumalanga.'

Angle 'Sabie River origin' description: 'CITES certified · since 1997' reads as a claim that the brand has existed since 1997. Only the farm's founding year is verified. Changed to 'Farm founded in 1997' (20 chars). CITES certification is still stated in the primary text.

Angle 'The everyday gift' primary_long: 'cut from a single piece of belly skin, so each cover has its own arrangement of scales' links two facts by cause and effect, which the sources do not support. The single piece only explains the uninterrupted pattern. Changed 'so' to 'and'.

All other fields passed and are unchanged: the €250 price (above the €100 free-shipping threshold, so 'free shipping' is true), the six colours and four iPad models, character limits, on-image lengths and format, reference-photo colours in the scenes (Cognac, Tobacco, Black, Red), prompt opening and closing wording, composition percentages and theme labels. No forbidden words, urgency, discounts or competitor comparisons were found.
